name: ena-stats-pipeline
description: Retrieves ENA assembly statistics for accession records and writes JSONL and/or BigQuery output

parameters.name: sdk_container_image
parameters.label: Worker SDK Container Image
parameters.helpText: Container image URI used for the Python SDK harness on Dataflow workers. This must contain your packaged pipelines and dependencies.

parameters.name: experiments
parameters.label: Experiments
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Dataflow experiments. For custom containers, Runner v2 is required. Use 'use_runner_v2' for batch.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.label: Pipeline Identifier
parameters.helpText: Which pipeline to launch. Use 'ena_stats' for this template.

parameters.name: accessions_file
parameters.label: Accessions File
parameters.helpText: Path to the newline-delimited taxonomy/accession JSONL input file.

parameters.name: output_jsonl
parameters.label: Stats Output Path (GCS)
parameters.helpText: Optional GCS path prefix for successful JSONL stats output.

parameters.name: errors_jsonl
parameters.label: Errors Output Path (GCS)
parameters.helpText: Optional GCS path prefix for JSONL error output.

parameters.name: bq_schema
parameters.label: BigQuery Schema Path
parameters.helpText: GCS path to the BigQuery schema JSON.

parameters.name: temp_location
parameters.label: GCS Temp Path
parameters.helpText: Temporary GCS path used for BigQuery file loads.

parameters.name: ena_api_delay_seconds
parameters.label: ENA API Delay Seconds
parameters.helpText: Seconds to sleep before each ENA API request per worker.
